visual_review.basis: Actual neutral native closed/open previews inspected; attachment, inset reveal, cavity/shelf and operating-state corrections reviewed.
visual_review.limits: Isolated asset presentation; host circulation, product engineering and actual installation remain separate.

analytic_motion_review.basis: Leaf/frame plan rectangles checked through the recorded staged100degree outer/165degree inner motion
required_sequence: Open both outer hinges from0to100degrees while each folding hinge stays0
Then fold inner leaves from0to165degrees; reverse this sequence to close
Do not drive all four hinge angles proportionally at once: opposite inner leaves can meet during motion
analytic_motion_review.limitations: Original staged concept mechanism; no manufacturer hinge specification or load rating.
